```{r setup, message=FALSE}
source("Setup.R")
```

```{r}
spe <- readRDS(file.path(path_rds, "spe.rds"))
```

##### Diagnostics before correction
```{r}
# Relative log expression of raw and logCPM counts, and PCA by category, scan, segment and group
plotRLExpr(spe, assay = 1, ordannots = "Patient") + xlab("") + ylab("RLE") + theme_classic()
plotRLExpr(spe, assay = 2, ordannots = "Patient", fill = Category) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Category, breaks = names(Category)) + xlab("") + ylab("RLE") + theme_classic()

set.seed(100)
spe <- scater::runPCA(spe)
pca_results <- reducedDim(spe, "PCA")

pca_by <- function(var, palette) {
  drawPCA(spe, precomputed = pca_results, col = "black") +
    geom_point(aes(fill = .data[[var]]), shape = 21, size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
    palette +
    theme_classic()
}
plot_grid(pca_by("Category", scale_fill_manual(values = Category, breaks = names(Category))),
          pca_by("Scan", scale_fill_manual(values = unname(Muted))),
          pca_by("Segment", scale_fill_manual(values = Segment)),
          pca_by("Group", scale_fill_manual(values = Group)),
          ncol = 2, align = "hv", axis = "r")
plotScreePCA(spe, precomputed = pca_results) + theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```

##### Normalisation and batch correction
```{r}
spe <- geomxNorm(spe, method = "TMM")

plotRLExpr(spe, assay = 2, fill = Category) + scale_fill_manual(values = Category, breaks = names(Category)) + xlab("") + ylab("RLE") + theme_classic()
plotRLExpr(spe, assay = 2, fill = Scan) + scale_fill_manual(values = unname(Muted)) + xlab("") + ylab("RLE") + theme_classic()
```

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.5}
# Negative control genes: top 300 by coefficient of variation, slide (Scan) as batch
spe <- findNCGs(spe, batch_name = "Scan", top_n = 300)

# Supplementary Figure 3a: silhouette score by number of unwanted factors k
bestk <- findBestK(spe,
                   factor_of_int = c("biology"),
                   factor_batch = "Scan_ID",
                   NCGs = S4Vectors::metadata(spe)$NCGs) +
  ylab("Silhouette Score") +
  theme_classic()
bestk
```

```{r}
spe_ruv <- geomxBatchCorrection(spe, factors = c("biology"), NCGs = metadata(spe)$NCGs, k = 3)
spe_ruv
```

```{r}
saveRDS(spe_ruv, file = file.path(path_rds, "spe_ruv.rds"))
```

##### Supplementary Figure 3
```{r}
set.seed(100)
spe_ruv <- scater::runPCA(spe_ruv)
pca_results_ruv <- reducedDim(spe_ruv, "PCA")

pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca_results_ruv)
pca_data$Category <- spe_ruv$Category
pca_data$Segment <- spe_ruv$Segment
pca_data$Group <- spe_ruv$Group

percentVar <- attr(pca_results_ruv, "percentVar")
pc_labels <- paste0("PC", 1:4, " (", round(percentVar[1:4], 1), "%)")
```

```{r}
# Pairs plot of PC1-PC4 coloured by `var`: upper triangle of scatter plots, legend bottom left
pairs_plot <- function(var, palette, axis = NULL) {
  scatter_plot <- function(x, y) {
    ggplot(pca_data, aes_string(x = x, y = y, fill = var)) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3, alpha = 0.9, color = "black") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = palette, breaks = names(palette)) +
      theme_classic() +
      labs(x = pc_labels[as.numeric(sub("PC", "", x))],
           y = pc_labels[as.numeric(sub("PC", "", y))])
  }
  legend <- get_legend(scatter_plot("PC1", "PC2") + theme(legend.position = "right"))
  p <- function(x, y) scatter_plot(x, y) + theme(legend.position = "none")
  args <- list(plot_grid(p("PC1", "PC2"), p("PC1", "PC3"), p("PC1", "PC4"), ncol = 3),
               plot_grid(legend, p("PC2", "PC3"), p("PC2", "PC4"), ncol = 3),
               plot_grid(NULL, NULL, p("PC3", "PC4"), ncol = 3),
               ncol = 1, align = "hv")
  if (!is.null(axis)) args$axis <- axis
  do.call(plot_grid, args)
}

category_plot <- pairs_plot("Category", Category)
seg_plot <- pairs_plot("Segment", Segment, axis = "l")
group_plot <- pairs_plot("Group", Group, axis = "l")
```

```{r, fig.width = 20, fig.height = 18}
# Supplementary Figure 3b: RLE after TMM + RUV4
RLE_cat <- plotRLExpr(spe_ruv, ordannots = "Patient", assay = 2, color = "black", fill = Category) +
  ggtitle("") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = Category, breaks = names(Category)) +
  ylab("RLE") +
  xlab("") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ruv <- plot_grid(bestk, RLE_cat, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.5, 0.5), labels = c("a", "b"), label_size = letter_size(15))
FigureS3 <- plot_grid(ruv, category_plot, seg_plot, group_plot,
                      ncol = 2, labels = c("", "c", "d", "e"), label_size = letter_size(15), rel_heights = c(2, 2))
FigureS3

save_plot(FigureS3, "FigureS3.svg", width = 15, height = 13.5)   # 15 in wide: prints at 50% on the page, like the other figures

# Single panels
save_plot(bestk, "FigureS3a.svg", width = 10, height = 4.5)
save_plot(RLE_cat, "FigureS3b.svg", width = 10, height = 4.5)
save_plot(category_plot, "FigureS3c.svg", width = 10, height = 9)
save_plot(seg_plot, "FigureS3d.svg", width = 10, height = 9)
save_plot(group_plot, "FigureS3e.svg", width = 10, height = 9)

# Source data (b: RLE box statistics per AOI, in plotting order)
save_source_data(bestk$data, "FigureS3a")
save_source_data(transmute(RLE_cat$data, Order = x, AOI = RestoolsMtchID, Patient, Category,
                           Lower_whisker = ymin, Q1 = lower, Median = middle, Q3 = upper, Upper_whisker = ymax),
                 "FigureS3b")
pcs <- pca_data[, paste0("PC", 1:4)]
names(pcs) <- pc_labels
save_source_data(cbind(pcs, Category = pca_data$Category), "FigureS3c", rownames_to = "AOI")
save_source_data(cbind(pcs, Segment = pca_data$Segment), "FigureS3d", rownames_to = "AOI")
save_source_data(cbind(pcs, Group = pca_data$Group), "FigureS3e", rownames_to = "AOI")
```
